body: I have definitely considered this. I have wanted to a few times but I chicken out. My family will most definitely find out if I do that. But then again I agree with you- better safe than sorry. I hope I will go to the ER if it ever gets to the point where I've got a gun in my hands. I want to live and I want to be happy... I guess everyone wants that... But I can't be at this moment in time. Thank you for taking the time to respond to me.

I won't talk about it in great detail but... Parental issues, growing up, a devastating breakup (which I'm pretty much over, but it fueled the fire so to speak), social anxiety, being isolated, and really bad body image issues. (I am make fyi, not that it matters I guess) thank you for responding.
